method: Schedule page re-read live on 2026-11-19 (platform page reader, 4 chunks, full text) and transcribed to schedule_live_2026-11-19.tsv; this script diffs that transcription against data/ea99006a/venetian.json row by row on date, start time, event number, name, structure-sheet number, buy-in and guarantee.
fields_not_compared: chips / levels / late_reg / house_fee: these live on the structure sheets, not on the schedule page
restart rows: no buy-in or guarantee is published for a Day 2 restart
name_suffix_note: The official page prints a promotional suffix after the structure-sheet title on these rows (for example 'Race to finish before the Race', 'POKERATLAS PRO MEMBER $20 RAKE DISCOUNT', 'Must be 50+ years of age to participate'). The stored rows keep the sheet title as the name and record the suffix in notes. This is informational: no date, start time, event number, buy-in, guarantee or sheet number differs.
